name: Realtime Voice Arena
author: finitecomputer
description: PersonaPlex 7B v1 evaluation surface with conversation and ephemeral pasted-text repeat tabs across twelve neutral named bundled voices.

dataPolicy.description: Live microphone audio or ephemeral local audio synthesized from pasted text is sent through a loopback credential relay to the authenticated Finite realtime endpoint. BenchLocal history stores operational session fields only; it does not retain pasted text, audio, or semantic content.
